messages:
Maria: dropping a proposal for a 'density toggle' on the rollout timeline + a stacked-label mode for tiny allocations. Figma: figma.com/... please skim and flag accessibility or copy issues.
Jake: Love the toggle idea. Two asks: 1) ensure keyboard state persists per user (not global), 2) how do we surface timeline bookmarks for long histories?
Maria: per-user preference stored on account settings, default to compact for heavy pages. Bookmarks: add pin icon on a version snapshot, visible in expanded history.
Aisha: accessibility notes: stacked labels must still expose clear aria-labels. Suggest pattern: aria-label="Variant B, 2 percent, started Apr 12, can rollback". Also ensure stacked labels don't collapse reading order for screen readers.
Sam: Rollback flow question: typed-confirm vs modal confirm? Typed confirm prevents accidental rollbacks but slows ops. Maybe typed-confirm only for production namespaces.
Priya: Ops agrees: typed-confirm for prod namespaces > 1M users. For smaller namespaces, modal + 2-step undo window ok. Also add a guard rail: require at least one user in on-call channel to acknowledge for immediate rollbacks.
Lee: microcopy: prefer 'Promote variant' and 'Rollback variant' verbs. For typed-confirm message, avoid ambiguous nouns; e.g., "Type ROLLBACK to confirm rollback of Variant B (3% -> 0%)". Keep short for translation.
Jake: timeline microscope request: when hovering a stack we show an inline mini-panel with commits, rollout author, and quick actions (Promote/Rollback/View logs). Quick actions should surface keyboard hints.
Maria: panel will have 3 quick actions max and show disabled state if an operation is in-flight. Also add inline policy badge (e.g., 'requires-approval') with tooltip explaining next steps.
Aisha: Animations: prefer reduced-motion crossfade when prefers-reduced-motion is set. When allocations change programmatically (auto-scale or traffic-shift), announce only the delta via aria-live polite, not the whole timeline.
Sam: metrics indicator: append small green/red sparkline in the mini-panel for error rate change. But ensure color alone isn't the only signal — add up/down carets and text.
Priya: localization: avoid colloquial verbs in tooltips, keep pattern like "Variant B — 2%". For confirmation copy, include absolute numbers where helpful ("This will move 20k requests/day").
Maria: action items summarized: - implement per-user density toggle (persisted) - stacked-labels with robust aria-label pattern - timeline microscope mini-panel with up to 3 quick actions + keyboard hints - rollback typed-confirm for prod only + undo toast for non-prod - aria-live polite deltas and reduced-motion crossfade - policy badges and metrics sparklines with textual fallback - update Figma + component tokens.
designbot: Design review requested by Maria for `density-toggle-rollout-panel`. Reviewers: Jake, Aisha, Sam, Priya, Lee. Deadline: 4 business days. :spiral_calendar:
Maria: thanks! I'll push the updated mocks and a brief implementation note (keyboard order, aria-label examples, reduced-motion CSS) into the design system repo. Ping when you review.
